expertisePage.intro: Four connected fields of applied science, one innovation partner for your protein and palatant needs.

proteins.title: Proteins
proteins.body: Overall protein consumption is predicted to nearly double by 2050. We are shifting from food security to protein security, and meeting it sustainably requires alternative sources. Whether plant, cell-cultured, precision-fermented or insect proteins, we help you navigate the options and pick what works for your product.
points: Portfolio scouting across plant, cell-cultured, fermented and insect proteins
Sourcing and testing strategy tailored to your application
Validation support from lab trials to industrial scale

enzymes.body: Enzymes help create value-added products with improved taste, smell and techno-functional properties, but choosing the right one is not easy. We interview you to understand your needs, then guide your tests to a best-fit portfolio.

insects.body: Insects offer a sustainable alternative to ease the supply of quality animal protein. Through ongoing market research we have identified the key players and the key farmed insects, and we know how insect materials rank against plant and animal proteins.

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.intro: Sinonin Biotech is built on the shoulders of expertise and experience in protein science and applied food enzymology.
aboutPage.nameBody: The business draws inspiration from the Nandi (Kenya) word “Sinonin”, which describes the lush green habitat teeming with diverse flora and fauna in the scenic Nandi County in Kenya's Great Rift Valley.
aboutPage.founderBody: Sinonin Biotech, part of the Sinonin Group of companies, was founded by Dr. rer. nat. habil. Seronei araap Chelulei Cheison. Seronei brings academic depth from protein chemistry research at Jiangnan University (Wuxi, China) and a German Habilitation at the Technical University of Munich, combined with industry leadership at MARS Petcare, where he led projects in alternative protein innovation and palatant development.
aboutPage.founderBody2: This business combines the two worlds: scientific rigor and the practical reality of new product development.
aboutPage.groupIntro: Sinonin Biotech is one of four companies in the Sinonin Group, which spans Kenyan agriculture, food production and vegan flavour solutions.

aboutPage.missionBody: We deliver value to our customers through leadership of disruptive innovation in alternative proteins and palatability enhancers, using deep applied-science expertise and new product development experience to drive change in raw material applications and validation.
aboutPage.visionBody: We aspire to be the go-to, customer-centric innovation partner for alternative proteins and palatants, knowledgeable, disruptive and reliable, helping our customers win sustainably and stay ahead of the competition.
